region: DataFeel Dot contact surface — activity-associated profile

loci.basis: NTC thermistor at contact surface. Mild warmth (36–40 °C) is associated with increased local metabolic activity and vasodilation. Thermoelectric element provides bidirectional control.

Normalised time-of-day (0.0 = midnight, 1.0 = midnight). Host-supplied raw clock phase; not measured by the device. Used as the clock source for the Origin-derived L-activity locus. Not directly used as an ABR interior locus in V0.4.

Cyclic trapezoidal activity schedule derived from the host clock. Peaks at 1.0 from 06:00 (phase 0.25) to 18:00 (phase 0.75). Rises from 0 to 1 between 05:00 and 06:00 (phase 0.208–0.25). Falls from 1 to 0 between 18:00 and 20:00 (phase 0.75–0.833). Zero at all other times including midnight. Schedule is cyclic: value at phase=0.0 equals value at phase=1.0. Declared by Origin; not synthetically constructed within the relational loop.

170 Hz resonant actuator. Pacinian corpuscles are most sensitive in the 200–300 Hz range; 170 Hz is within the activation window. Vibrotactile stimulation at moderate amplitude activates large-diameter Aβ afferents, consistent with gate-control analgesic pathways. Activity profile uses higher amplitude and shorter pulse duration.

RGB blue channel, ~466 nm. Intrinsically photosensitive retinal ganglion cells (ipRGCs) expressing melanopsin have peak sensitivity near 480 nm; 466 nm is within the activation range. Blue-enriched illumination during the active phase is associated with circadian synchronisation and suppression of melatonin secretion (Brainard et al., 2001; Thapan et al., 2001). This association is retinal and systemic, not a local tissue effect of the Dot LED.

relations.description: Thermal disturbance (A) drives haptic amplitude (R) gated by the declared activity profile (B = L-activity). During the activity schedule window (L-activity high, 06:00–18:00), thermal changes produce stronger haptic response. At midnight and during the rest window, L-activity is zero and haptic output is suppressed. Same gate as R-02 — both modalities are coupled through the same Origin interior locus, producing joint co-activity in the declared activity window.

Thermal disturbance (A) drives blue optical output (R) gated by the declared activity profile (B = L-activity). During the activity schedule window (L-activity high, 06:00–18:00), thermal changes produce blue-enriched illumination consistent with daytime circadian entrainment. The same Origin gate as R-01 means haptic and optical outputs are simultaneously expressed in the declared activity window — the area of multimodal co-activity.

provenance: Robin Macomber, Metatron Dynamics, Inc. — 2026-10-21. V0.4 activity-associated profile. ABR operator with Origin-declared activity schedule interior locus. Scientific basis in docs/verification_record.md.
